name: io.github.MetExplore/mcp-metexplore
title: MetExplore
description: Query MetExplore metabolic networks: organisms, metabolites, reactions, metabolite and gene mapping

environmentVariables.name: METEXPLORE_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MetExplore application key, to request from contact-metexplore@inrae.fr

environmentVariables.name: METEXPLORE_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: MetExplore user token (account profile), to also access your private networks

environmentVariables.name: METEXPLORE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the MetExplore API (default: production)

headers.name: X-MetExplore-Token
headers.description: MetExplore user token, to also access your private networks (public networks without it)
